checks.name: a start from the jump list («الاستوديو») opens its place on the site
Windows keeps a jump list for the application (its settings read back)
a second start from the jump list («يحتاج قرارك») leaves at once and moves the open window to its place
a start that names an address instead of a place moves nothing
the page's progress is the taskbar's bar
a failure turns the bar red at its last fraction, and looking at the window clears it
a bar ends with the document that set it
anything else is refused by the main process, and shows nothing

checks.name: a file the person chose is dragged out by its token: Windows is handed that file, with the brand mark
an unknown, a malformed or a forgotten token drags nothing
cache.usage names the default folder «المجلد الافتراضي», with no path and no Windows user name
a chosen folder is named by its last name only

notes: The drag itself is Windows' own and cannot be driven by Playwright: dropping into Explorer is an owner walkthrough step.
